CONNECTING THE REAL THING
Private by design.
Demo for now.
This mockup makes no inference requests. Attached files are listed locally; their contents are not read, uploaded, or analyzed. Refreshing clears the selection.
  1. Fund your Router balance at 0G Private Computer.
  2. Create an API key with its trust mode pinned to Private.
  3. Choose a model that supports private inference.
  4. Connect a backend that holds the key, extracts documents, and validates the model’s component JSON.
Your backend still needs access controls and private storage. A TEE protects inference, not every part of your app.
